answer: Give every identity one anchor niche, chosen by hash of its key, and let standing grow only as that niche deepens: strangers periodically question it, and its answers must build on its own earlier answers in that niche, new tendrils from the same vine. An honest agent tends one patch and knows it cold. A sybil farm must keep a thousand distinct expertises alive at once; sharing notes makes the masks' answers converge word-for-word, and neglecting a niche lets it wither when the tide of questions comes in — either way the crowd costs as much as real specialists.
